body:
📦 SimpleTrade (1.20+)
A lightweight, high-performance, and secure trading plugin designed for modern Paper and Spigot servers.
✨ Features
• Safe Trading: Secure GUI-based trading system to prevent scamming.
• Lightweight: Built with Paper API for maximum performance and zero lag.
• Vanilla+ Experience: Seamlessly integrates into your server without breaking the vanilla feel.
• Fast Commands: Simple /trade <player> command for quick access.
🛠️ Commands & Permissions
• /trade <player> - Sends a trade request to the specified player.
• Permission: simpletrade.use (Default: true)
🚀 Installation
1. Download the SimpleTrade.jar file.
2. Drop it into your server's plugins folder.
3. Restart your server.
4. Enjoy secure trading!
